structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness

discovery-weak-signals.name: AI infrastructure bottleneck exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: 1.6T Ethernet, rack-scale switching and high-density optics directly address bandwidth, power and cooling constraints as accelerator clusters scale.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Ecosystem and standards leverage
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Named hyperscaler/cloud collaborators plus AMD/Broadcom silicon relationships and the XPO multi-source approach broaden adoption paths.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Platform breadth
discovery-weak-signals.basis: EOS/CloudVision, AI fabrics, campus and VeloCloud security create multiple adjacent deployment surfaces rather than a single hardware cycle.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Product transition timing
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Several next-generation 1.6T and security products remain scheduled for Q4 2026 or Q1 2027, so roadmap conversion is still an execution dependency.

adversarial-red-team.name: financialOperatingMomentum
adversarial-red-team.basis: Record quarterly revenue supports present execution rather than roadmap-only claims.

adversarial-red-team.name: substitutionResilience
adversarial-red-team.basis: Ethernet is credible but faces proprietary and customer-designed alternatives.

adversarial-red-team.name: pricingPower
adversarial-red-team.basis: Reviewed evidence does not isolate AI-fabric product pricing or margins.

expectations-execution.name: Execution versus narrative
expectations-execution.basis: Record quarterly revenue and named hyperscaler/cloud validation support the claim that Arista is already executing at scale while advancing its AI networking portfolio.

expectations-execution.name: Expectation conversion risk
expectations-execution.basis: Important 1.6T, liquid-cooled and ETM products are not all generally available yet; future adoption and economics remain to be demonstrated.

expectations-execution.name: Competitive positioning
expectations-execution.basis: Open Ethernet and EOS create flexibility, but AI networking remains contested by proprietary fabrics, merchant-silicon peers and customer-designed alternatives.

expectations-execution.name: Security-level valuation
expectations-execution.basis: No canonical live price/valuation input was present in the reviewed work item; Scout does not promote an entry or valuation conclusion.
